# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop owner downloads the report as an Excel (XLSX) file (requested by Haruto; blocked by ADR 0011, see tasks/TASK-016.md).

# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: blocked (no XLSX; export stays CSV-only)

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- Mira's message "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy" is not a ruling on formats and does not supersede docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md (Accepted; its Words: "CSV only; I will not maintain a second export format."). So the export was left as it is; nothing was implemented.
- Open: if Mira wants XLSX for Haruto, she needs to say so explicitly (a new ADR superseding 0011). Meanwhile Haruto's accountant can open the CSV in a spreadsheet tool.
